result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one significant text layout collision in the restaurant list and one minor content typo/label issue. The rest of the page appears generally coherent.

issues.description: In the "Popular right now" section, the restaurant details row is crowded: the delivery time/cuisine text on the left overlaps or runs too close to the rating on the right, making the information hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Rework the card metadata layout so the left and right fields have dedicated space, or stack the rating onto a separate line to prevent text collision.

issues.description: The delivery line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears to contain a typo or clipped text (looks like "deivery" instead of "delivery").
issues.suggestion: Verify the label text and spacing in the card footer to ensure the full word renders correctly.
